title: Super Mario World -- Credits Warp in 5:59.6 (First Time Ever on Console)
summary: SethBling performs the first credits warp in Super Mario World on a real SNES console, a glitch that plays the ending without beating Bowser. The run relies on pixel-perfect positioning and tools such as a helper ROM hack.
why: Cited as a landmark of speedrunning, where a trick once limited to tool-assisted runs was pulled off live on hardware.

quote.text: his brief videos give a really nice introduction to the topic that should be accessible to most people
